item.title: Japan expands public insurance to cover full cost of childbirth | Live Action
item.description: Japan has launched a milestone policy that is poised to cover the entire cost of childbirth via its national health insurance system to help the birth rate.

item.title: Abortion pill ad removed from art exhibit in pro-life Malta | Live Action
item.description: An ad offering abortion pills in pro-life Malta was removed from an art exhibit. The pro-abortion group behind it claims its artwork is being censored.

item.title: DEFUND 250: 10 times Planned Parenthood misled clients and the public | Live Action
item.description: Deceptive marketing, scheming to hide abortion pill complications, blaming Congress' defund for its own planned closures - these are just some of the lies.

item.title: New poll finds majority of young Japanese adults never want children | Live Action
item.description: A majority of adults in Japan have reported they plan to remain child-free, as the country's birth rate continues to plummet.

item.title: GUEST OPINION: Why abortion shouldn't be a default response to cancer during pregnancy | Live Action
item.description: Women diagnosed with cancer during pregnancy have multiple options, despite stories that appear to advocate abortion in such circumstances.

item.title: New Zealand fertility clinic admits family's embryos have 'gone missing' | Live Action
item.description: The clinic said this involved one patient, there are no other missing embryos, and the embryos weren't implanted into anyone else. Still, these remain missing.

item.title: Coroner: Hospital's 'neglect' played role in 27-week preemie's 2024 death | Live Action
item.description: After examining the sequence of events a coroner determined that the baby girl's death was an “accident contributed to by neglect."

item.title: Abortionist and serial killer Kermit Gosnell reportedly dead at 85 | Live Action
item.description: Pro-life advocates believe the real number of Kermit Gosnell's victims across the decades could total into the thousands.

item.title: 'Protect the next generation': South Dakota governor signs 3 life-affirming bills | Live Action
item.description: The bills seek to stop abortion pills from being sent into the state, to further education about life in the womb, and offer clarity in pro-life laws.

item.title: Holy See urges UN to reject all forms of surrogacy | Live Action
item.description: Archbishop Gabriele Caccia said that “technology and practice have run laps around the law and ethics."
